rules.title: Raw hash signing (eth_sign)
rules.detail: This can authorize almost anything. Almost no legitimate app needs it.

rules.title: Signing an opaque 32-byte hash
rules.detail: The message is a raw hash, which could be a disguised transaction or order.

rules.title: Permission goes to a personal wallet, not an app
rules.detail: Legitimate apps use contracts. Giving a personal wallet permission over your assets is the #1 drainer pattern.

rules.title: Unlimited token permission
rules.detail: Grants permission to move ALL of this token, now and in the future.

rules.title: Full collection permission
rules.detail: Lets this address move every NFT you own in this collection.

rules.title: Long-lived or unlimited permit
rules.detail: This permission lasts more than 30 days or has no amount cap.

rules.title: Gasless token transfer signature
rules.detail: Once relayed, this signature moves your tokens immediately.

rules.title: Listing your NFTs for ~0
rules.detail: This order sells your assets for almost nothing.

rules.title: Known drainer address
rules.detail: This address appears on PlainSign's community-maintained drainer list.

rules.title: Contract is less than 7 days old
rules.detail: Brand-new contracts are common in scams.

rules.title: Unverified contract source
rules.detail: Nobody can review what this code does.

rules.title: Website doesn't match the protocol
rules.detail: This site is not a known domain for the contract it's calling.

rules.title: You lose assets and receive nothing
rules.detail: Simulation shows only outgoing balance changes.

rules.title: Transaction would fail
rules.detail: Simulation reverted; you'd likely just lose gas.

rules.title: Unrecognized action
rules.detail: PlainSign can't tell exactly what this function does.

rules.title: Signature is for a different network
rules.detail: This signature is valid on another chain than the one your wallet is on. Shared contract addresses (like Permit2) can make it look familiar.

rules.title: Known protocol on its official site
rules.detail: Target is a recognized contract and this website is expected.
